title: Online Acceptance and Commitment Therapy for Reducing Anxiety
brief_summary: The main objective of this study is to test the effectiveness of an Internet-delivered Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) program in reducing anxiety symptoms.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* be fluent in Romanian
* be over 18 years of age
* have high levels of anxiety
* have access to an Internet-connected computer

Exclusion Criteria:

* suicidal ideation
* substance abuse
* severe psychiatric disorders
* a recent change in psychotropic medication (i.e., the dose has been changed within the last month)
